thread:
noah: hey! first week here. need Console Env Panel access: qa admin for onboarding tests, prod readonly to view runbooks. who should i contact?
linda: welcome noah :tada: open infra-permissions and paste manager approval. infra can usually grant QA admin same day.
noah: can someone paste the ticket body i should use?
linda: use this minimal body:
```
Title: Env panel access for noah
Requester: noah
Manager: <manager-name>
Environments: qa(admin), prod(readonly)
Flags: onboarding.*
Duration: 14 days
Reason: onboarding verification
```
ops: note: prod readonly often requires SCIM group membership (prod-viewers). if infra asks, they'll add you to that group; expect up to 1 hour delay.
noah: opened ticket INF-7019 and included manager signoff.
access-bot: verification: Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" OR API: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq. Look for "env_panel" roles for qa and prod.
ops: infra granted QA admin. prod readonly pending SCIM sync, queued. we'll update this thread when done.
noah: thanks all, i'll wait for prod before touching runbooks.
